about.heading: About this build
about.body: OpenEduLab is an open-source teaching tool: no accounts, no installs, experiments run in the browser.
about.noAccounts: M1 has no accounts, no student records and no tracking pixels. The no-login build is a provisional reading of the charter and is still pending owner confirmation.
about.licensePending: Code and content licences are not final. All art and text in this slice are original to this repository.
about.privacyBody: Slider values, graph state and feedback text never leave the browser in this build. Product events are whitelisted aggregates and analytics is disabled by default.
